info.title: SmartCura Asynchronous API
info.description: Stage 0A contract for Socket.IO application events, MQTT device traffic and PostgreSQL transactional-outbox processing.

socketio.description: Authenticated Socket.IO transport using the SmartCura session cookie

mqtt.description: Mosquitto device broker with one TLS credential and ACL per provisioned device

postgresOutbox.description: Private transactional outbox table claimed by the worker with SKIP LOCKED; not a public broker

redisPubSub.description: Redis pub/sub bridge between the worker and API WebSocket gateway instances. The worker publishes minimum-necessary chat event projections after processing an outbox row; every gateway instance subscribes and fans out to the matching conversation room. Not a public broker.

socketioApp.description: Socket.IO namespace. User room is joined automatically; resource rooms require a policy-checked subscribe command.

socketioChat.description: Dedicated Socket.IO namespace for real-time consultation chat. A client authenticates with the SmartCura session cookie on the WebSocket handshake, joins the room for a conversation they are an active participant in, and receives push events for new messages, receipt updates, and presence changes. The HTTP send/read endpoints remain the only write path; this namespace is push-only. CSRF does not apply to WebSocket frames, but session authentication is enforced on every connection.

chatEvents.description: Redis pub/sub channel the worker publishes chat fan-out events to and every API WebSocket gateway instance subscribes to. One channel for all chat events; the payload carries its own conversation_id so each instance can fan out to the right room without a per-conversation channel. The payload is the minimum-necessary projection — no message text, which is clinical data an event stream fans out more widely than an authorized read.

mqttStatus.description: Retained latest status/LWT; consumers must evaluate reported_at and never infer clinical truth from it.

postgresOutboxEvents.description: Worker claim stream. Domain transaction and outbox row commit atomically; worker routes minimum-necessary projections to Socket.IO, FCM and providers.
postgresOutboxEvents.x-claim: FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED with lease, retry, dead-letter and replay

receiveSocketCommands.summary: API receives policy-checked room subscription and resume commands

sendSocketEvents.summary: API sends authorized room events; no PHI is broadcast to unscoped rooms

receiveChatCommands.summary: API receives authenticated join, leave, and typing commands. Authorization is enforced by a database read against conversation_participants; a non-participant is refused and never added to the room. The sender identity is taken from the authenticated socket, never from the payload.

sendChatEvents.summary: API pushes authorized room events to conversation participants. No message text or clinical data is broadcast; clients refetch under policy for content.

publishChatFanOut.summary: Worker publishes minimum-necessary chat event projections to Redis after processing a conversation.message-created.v1 or conversation.receipt-updated.v1 outbox row. Every gateway instance receives the pub/sub message and fans out to the matching conversation room.

processOutbox.summary: Worker claims persisted events, executes side effects and marks processed/retry/dead-letter

deviceCredential.description: Unique broker credential bound to one provisioned device and ACL

deviceId.description: Provisioned server UUIDv7; broker ACL and credential identity must match the topic

DeviceChangedData.description: Registration, state change, assignment or release of a device. Serial numbers and assignment detail stay in the audit log.

VitalReadingChangedData.description: One accepted vital reading. Carries no measured value or unit: the value is clinical data and an event stream fans out more widely than an authorized read.

HealthAlertStateChangedData.description: Payload of the published health_alert.changed.v1 event. Distinct from the older speculative health.alert_changed.v1 message, whose state and metric vocabularies predate the implemented enums. observed_value is excluded because it is clinical data.

ProfileDetailChangedData.description: One extended patient profile detail row changed. Deliberately coarse: it says an address, contact, allergy or condition list changed, never its content.

DoctorDetailChangedData.description: A doctor membership's professional detail changed. accepts_new_patients is published because a directory cache has to know availability flipped; biography and fee are not.

VerificationDocumentChangedData.description: A verification document was requested, submitted or reviewed. Object identity, scan state and derived membership verification status stay in the audit log.

AvailabilityChangedData.description: A doctor's availability rules, exceptions or generated slots changed. slot_count is the number of slots the mutation affected; times and reasons stay in the audit log.

AppointmentChangedData.description: Minimum-necessary appointment lifecycle projection. No time, fee, payment amount or clinical detail is published; consumers refetch under policy.

VitalMetric.description: Scalar readings only. ecg_voltage is a bounded spot/summary value; ECG waveform samples use the later object-storage upload flow and never this packet.

metrics.description: One scalar sample per metric for this device boot/sequence. Duplicate metric names are rejected; waveform samples are excluded.

DoctorReviewChangedData.description: Minimum-necessary review projection. Comment, tags, appointment and patient identity are deliberately excluded.

FileScanRequestedData.description: Minimum-data scan command. The worker resolves the object key, content metadata and checksum from PostgreSQL rather than publishing them.

FileScanCompletedData.description: Terminal scan projection. Object keys, checksums, scanner signatures and owner identity remain in the database/audit boundary.

AppointmentPaymentRequestedData.description: Minimum-data payment command. Amount, patient, appointment and provider reference are resolved from PostgreSQL by the worker.

AiArtifactChangedData.description: Minimum data only: no content, summary text, risk detail or confidence. A subscriber refetches through an authorized read.

PharmacyOrderChangedData.description: Minimum data only: no patient identity, medication, quantity or batch. A subscriber refetches through an authorized site-scoped read.

DispatchAssignmentChangedData.description: Minimum data only: no recipient identity, address or coordinates. A driver client refetches recipient details through the assigned-only disclosure route.

ChatConversationCommand.description: Client command to join, leave, or broadcast a typing indicator for a conversation. The sender identity is taken from the authenticated socket, never from the payload. Authorization to join is enforced by a database read against conversation_participants.

ChatPresenceEvent.description: Presence status change for a profile. Broadcast to every conversation room the profile is an active participant in. The room list is read from the database so the broadcast never reaches a room the profile left. A 45-second offline grace period absorbs brief reconnects without flapping presence.
